name: language-distiller
description: Turn language-course material (course books, lecture slides, handouts, notes) into compact study sheets, a phone study app with audio, flashcards and games, and listening episodes. German is the reference language.

plugins.name: language-distiller
plugins.description: Distill lessons into vocabulary / grammar / phrase sheets with a closing story (German: Wortschatz, Grammatik, Redemittel, Geschichte), an offline study app (each language spoken by its own voice, repeats on tap, plays with the screen off, one-tap spaced repetition, lesson games) and MP3 listening episodes.
